notes.title: Accessibility and User Interface Upgrade: update v0.1.12
notes.content:
[b]version 0.1.12 changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] added the option to lock the minimap towards north

[*] corrected AI behavior at high and low speeds 

[*] Upgraded the visualisation of selected buttons

[*] corrected the chrono menu crashing the game

[*] corrected chronos being over 100000 seconds or negative 

[*] updated vehicle UI: now "wrong direction" is bigger and "finished!" does print on screen when the race is finished
[/list]

notes.title: Nova Frontier Circuit and Manual driving tweaks: update v0.1.11
notes.content:
[b]version 0.1.11 changelog: [/b]

[list]
[*] added several buildings in the nova frontier circuit

[*] made Nova Frontier circuit a finished map; now working on two other ones

[*] corrected the reverse function: now reverse as brake is deactivated, reverse switches automatically when automatic gears is selected and the car is almost at stop, but it doesn't when the driving mode is manual. 

[*] corrected car behavior when oversteering: some cars now have more adherence, steers better, and don't do barrels for a small steering angle.
[/list]

notes.title: going full manual! (update v0.1.10)
notes.content:
[b]list of changes: [/b]

[list]
[*] now, you have the ability to drive fully manual: change speeds by yourself! 

[*] you can also deactivate / activate ABS and traction control

[*] finally, there is an option to change steering sensitivity from x1 to x4
[/list]
